# Campaign results — pooled per run (generated by render_results.py)

Campaigns `meas-ci:interactive:2026-09-18` and `meas-ci:playback:2026-09-18` (`soffice`, `gimp`, `kdenlive`, `mpv-video`, `mpv-audio`) and `meas-ci:interactive:2026-09-19` (`thunderbird-send`), the same-machine re-observation under the machine gate (D26) — every repeat on one AMD EPYC 7763, pinned to one CPU (pin.sh; method §4). The six applications whose stability rule holds; `chrome`, `code` and `webrtc` are re-measured under D51, D53 and D54 and land in a later render (D55). `thunderbird-send` leaves out repeat 29 (D47).

Numbers are pooled over the repeats listed with each application; its phase lengths are the method's, §2 and the settles and phases §9's amendments name. `spread` is the range of the per-repeat p50. Threads are the top five by CPU. Per-input rules are method §5's (a) first-wake, (b) window minus idle rate, (c) waker (X-server-woken schedule-ins). Runner: `ubuntu-24.04`, 4 vCPU, kernel per `reports/*.spec.json`.
